actors.role: Deputy Prime Minister of Italy and Secretary of Lega
actors.blurb: Matteo Salvini remains a central figure in Italian politics, particularly due to his leadership of the Lega party and his stance on alliances within the right-wing coalition. Recent coverage highlights his exclusion of General Roberto Vannacci from future alliances, his push for primaries in mayoral elections, and his ongoing tensions with other political figures, including Giorgia Meloni. Salvini's role in shaping Italy's immigration and security policies continues to generate debate.
